hypothesis: A definable Japanese customer segment has frequent, material cross-merchant purchase or delivery friction.
closed_scope: No frequency is established. Redelivery in the MLIT sample is real, falling, and largely inside carrier tools.
unresolved_remainder: Residual friction by job, in an activity-selected cohort and, separately, in an incident-selected cohort.
key_unknown: Job-level residual after the tools the person already uses.
decision_implication: Do not size a segment. Do not let the incident cohort stand in for prevalence.

hypothesis: Current merchant apps, carrier notifications, email, wallets, and aggregators do not already solve it adequately.
closed_scope: The broad claim that notification and timeline jobs are unserved. Parcel, Gmail, Yamato, Yahoo, and Rakuten omatome occupy that claim.
unresolved_remainder: Incremental value for a defined segment after those tools, including setup.
key_unknown: The size of any leftover job.
next_test: GRO-E000 then GRO-E006 only if delivery is selected
decision_implication: Do not build a generic timeline. The incremental question stays open inside one discovery round.

hypothesis: Enough users will grant the data access and transaction authority required.
closed_scope: Full-inbox OAuth is a restricted scope and was not the test.
unresolved_remainder: Willingness to show one redacted screen or tracking number, measured on the same people who have the problem.
key_unknown: Joint behavior, not a stated intention.
decision_implication: One pre-committed capture method. No OAuth and no second channel after refusal.

hypothesis: A startup can obtain sufficient permitted, durable merchant, carrier, and payment access.
closed_scope: Delegated Amazon on-behalf ordering is prohibited if the English 6(k) text returned by the co.jp policies URL is operative. A consumer-wide order API was not found. UCP order events are merchant-pushed.
unresolved_remainder: Whether a qualifying referral surface or a written partner path can be obtained. Japanese Associates text is unread.
key_unknown: The Japanese operating agreement and any named approval.
next_test: Permission memo before any execution test
decision_implication: Do not book delegated Amazon affiliate revenue. Do not claim that no merchant relationship could ever be obtained.

hypothesis: Agentic checkout produces meaningful incremental benefit over existing checkout.
closed_scope: A generic in-chat checkout lacked the flexibility OpenAI said it wanted. That is the closed interface claim.
unresolved_remainder: Japanese time savings against saved details and familiar payment. Other assistance designs.
key_unknown: Measured checkout time in Japan, and a permitted path.
next_test: GRO-E000 checkout questions. Execution stays blocked.
decision_implication: Do not say the attempt failed to become a habit. Do not test live execution yet.

hypothesis: Tracking and checkout reinforce each other commercially.
closed_scope: Nothing. Yahoo's about 20% is in-mall discovery, not a tracking-to-checkout conversion.
unresolved_remainder: Whether the same person has both burdens, and whether one causes the other.
key_unknown: A conversion observation. Absence is not zero.
next_test: GRO-E000 may note co-occurrence. It does not authorize a combined build.
decision_implication: Do not design one company around both jobs.

hypothesis: Japan-specific requirements create an advantage worth more than the associated complexity.
closed_scope: Nothing positive. Points use inside existing programs is mainstream and does not close a cross-ecosystem comparison.
unresolved_remainder: Whether a comparison changes a real basket by more than the effort.
next_test: GRO-E005R only if GRO-E000 selects this job
decision_implication: Do not treat localization or points as a moat. Do not drop the job because points are popular.

hypothesis: Customers can be acquired and retained through a realistic channel.
closed_scope: A free path on surfaces the incumbents own was not found. That does not close paid or shared-economics channels.
unresolved_remainder: Paid CPI, activation, and retention for one specific job.
key_unknown: A quoted acquisition cost for a defined offer.
next_test: No acquisition test until one job survives GRO-E000.
decision_implication: Do not model 10000 retained users. Do not claim that no channel exists.

hypothesis: Contribution economics remain attractive after failures, support, incentives, and acquisition costs.
closed_scope: Nothing universal. Under v1 assumptions the base contribution is -29.04 and the upside is 274.64 before omitted costs, and delegated Amazon revenue is not addressable.
unresolved_remainder: Eligibility, adoption, failure mix, support, omitted costs, activation, and retention.
key_unknown: Which scenario, if any, resembles a real permitted segment.
next_test: Per-case or per-job costs inside the one selected follow-on.
decision_implication: Do not raise or set a price. Do not treat the base case as the central estimate.

hypothesis: The company can defend value against incumbents, fast followers, and disintermediation.
closed_scope: No positive defense of a venture-scale cross-merchant consumer agent was established. Bundling exposure is supported as a risk.
unresolved_remainder: Whether a narrow job remains after incumbents and Parcel.
key_unknown: The leftover job, if GRO-E000 finds one.
next_test: Not a company question inside this round.
decision_implication: Incumbents using a model does not by itself prove the model cannot help a startup. Impossibility is not shown.

hypothesis: A specific recent change improves feasibility or demand for this startup.
closed_scope: No startup-specific why-now was established. OpenAI's March 2026 change is adverse to one interface.
unresolved_remainder: Whether any bounded design became more feasible. Not researched beyond that interface.
key_unknown: A mechanism that helps a startup rather than only the incumbent.
next_test: None. Do not start a new why-now literature pass.
decision_implication: Do not start because model quality improved.

hypothesis: The result can be a durable independent company rather than a feature, a low-margin service, or an inaccessible platform dependency.
closed_scope: No positive case for a venture-scale independent consumer company.
unresolved_remainder: C08, logistics, SKU data, and physical-AI, which were not researched. A small service, which is not this hypothesis.
key_unknown: The four-part overlap after GRO-E000: value, permission, economics, acquisition.
next_test: Park the theme if that overlap is absent.
decision_implication: Do not score unresearched themes as losers or as alternatives that win by default.
